sources.title: WLCR-SEA Predictor - GitHub
sources.snippet: WLCR-SEA (Window-Local Context Representation with Seasonal Expert Attention) is a request-local cellular-traffic forecaster. A prediction request consumes one target cell's ordered 336-hour traffic history and observation mask, then produces 24 future hours for four traffic indicators.
